tasks.label: 🚀 test locally (uninstall -> pack -> install)
tasks.command: dotnet tool uninstall --global Tools.AIBridge; dotnet pack ${workspaceFolder}/src/AIBridge.Cli/AIBridge.Cli.csproj -c Release -p:PublishAot=false -p:SelfContained=false; dotnet tool install --global --add-source ${workspaceFolder}/src/AIBridge.Cli/bin/Release/ Tools.AIBridge --version 0.0.0

tasks.label: 🚀 test MCP locally (uninstall -> pack -> install)
tasks.command: dotnet tool uninstall --global Tools.AIBridge.Mcp; dotnet pack ${workspaceFolder}/src/AIBridge.Mcp/AIBridge.Mcp.csproj -c Release; dotnet tool install --global --add-source ${workspaceFolder}/src/AIBridge.Mcp/bin/Release/ Tools.AIBridge.Mcp

tasks.label: 🔨 build AOT binary (local test)
tasks.command: dotnet publish ${workspaceFolder}/src/AIBridge.Cli/AIBridge.Cli.csproj -c Release -r linux-x64 -p:PublishAot=true -p:SelfContained=true -o ${workspaceFolder}/publish/test && echo '' && echo '--- Verifying binary ---' && ${workspaceFolder}/publish/test/ai-bridge --version && ${workspaceFolder}/publish/test/ai-bridge --help

windows.command: dotnet publish '${workspaceFolder}\src\AIBridge.Cli\AIBridge.Cli.csproj' -c Release -r win-x64 -p:PublishAot=true -p:SelfContained=true -o '${workspaceFolder}\publish\test'; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '--- Verifying binary ---'; & '${workspaceFolder}\publish\test\ai-bridge.exe' --version; & '${workspaceFolder}\publish\test\ai-bridge.exe' --help
